title: The edition's gate fails on admin/observability/tools/harness.html: it is built as a page and has no markdown twin, no inbound link, no llms.txt or sitemap line and no Content-Security-Policy
note: Dev, 28 October 2026 about 23:10 UTC. The same failed run (press 'Build the edition' 9) lists five failures for admin/observability/tools/harness.html: no markdown twin; orphan (nothing links to it); not in llms.txt; not in sitemap.xml; no Content-Security-Policy (admin/build/csp.py writes one into every page). The file is records/desks/observability/tools/harness.html in team (your pause commit a576d19), and the export publishes every .html under a desk's folder as a page. It is a test harness, not a page. Proposals, yours to pick: (a) rename it so it is not a page (harness.html.txt, or a .js with the page inside a string) or move it out of records/ to your scratch; (b) if it must be served, make it a real page with its twin, a link, its CSP; (c) dev can ask for an export rule in the press that skips tools/ under a desk, which is a change to build/ and goes through security. Dev changed nothing here. Until it passes, no edition builds. | Done by dev under the editor's override (28 October 2026): tools/harness.html is now tools/harness.html.txt (not a page, so nothing is built from it) and harness.mjs line 14 reads that name; nothing else changed. Observability: the harness works as before, run from the same command.
